title: Escape Room NYC

services.name: Escape Rooms
services.desc: Step back in time and land in the middle of New York’s most infamous penitentiary, Rikers Island. The guard’s steps echo down the hallway, and your heart’s racing. Can you and your team unravel the cryptic clues left behind and escape before you’re caught? Ever heard a door creak in an empty room? Check into The Grange Hotel, and you just might. The ghostly whispers and haunted hallways are just part of the charm. Can you keep your nerve, decipher the cryptic messages, and check out before time is up? Step right up folks and see the World’s Premier Circus! Featuring incredible acts of strength, magic beyond comprehension, and most importantly, YOU! Supernatural Activities? Nonsense! Here at

quotes.author: Max W
quotes.text: one of the best escape room experiences" This is definitely one of the best escape room experiences I had. We played the Haunted Hotel, and the love for detail and atmosphere is incredible. The puzzles were very creative, and overall the experience was the most immersive I have had with escape rooms. I’d also like to thank our host Sawyer who was very nice and helpful! Definitely will come back for the other games.

quotes.author: Vanessa Ip
quotes.text: 100% recommend this place" The experience begins as soon as you step out of the elevator, so be prepared to feel a little scared, but it was definitely a pleasant surprise. The escape room itself was very fun and interactive. We had Ryan supervise us, and he was super witty and fun with his hints. For the price, this was soo worth it. Will for sure visit again 🙂

quotes.author: Thomonique Moore
quotes.text: We’ll definitely be back!" Had such a great time!! Even though we didn’t solve the room, it was so much fun solving the puzzles. We did one of the hardest rooms on medium, and it really is a fun challenge! Our game master Bryon was great and super helpful also without giving too much away. We’ll definitely be back!

quotes.author: Rob Neuerman
quotes.text: Fantastic experience." Great spooky ambiance from before you enter the escape room proper. Haunted Hotel had a great creepy vibe and cool puzzles that were just the right difficulty. Our GM, Brion, did great at giving balanced hints and made the whole process super fun.

quotes.author: Patrick
quotes.text: well-designed and quite spooky" We did the haunted hotel room. It was very well-designed and quite spooky. The puzzles made sense, and it was easy to find the order of which lock to work on next. The design was also full of surprises! Our game master Brion was awesome too. He kept a close watch and provided hints whenever he saw us getting stuck. 10/10 would come back!

quotes.author: William
quotes.text: Amazing Experience" We did the Haunted Hotel. And it was amazing! The atmosphere was perfect, and the right amount of creepy and horror. Nothing dangerous. The puzzles were well made, and Sawyer, our host, did a fantastic job making us feel capable with the clues. After it was all said and done, Sawyer was the nicest person and made us feel proud with how we did.

quotes.author: Rachel Fiorito
quotes.text: Had a great time" Had a great time even though we didn't make it out. After doing so many rooms, I always am impressed when I can't get out. Thanks to Sawyer for making us feel better at the end and telling us what we missed. 75% done is better than nothing.

quotes.author: Casey Grenier
quotes.text: We had so much fun!" We had so much fun! Went for a birthday and it was so amazing! And Bryon was a great host! If you are looking for a fun activity with your friends, a unique date idea, a cool birthday party, or a team-building exercise with colleagues. BrainXcape is a great idea. We did the haunted hotel set with my friends. It was awesome! We have to go back to try the old prison!!!

quotes.author: Angel S
quotes.text: took my sister here for her birthday" I took my sister here for her birthday! You were immediately immersed into the game as you get off the elevator and the hallway is dark and spooky. I thought the rooms were well decorated. The only thing I wish was that there was like a story like why we are in the hotel etc. it also wasn’t that scary but it was enjoyable and we all loved the TV.

quotes.author: Erin
quotes.text: had a great time" We went as a birthday present to me and had a really great time. Brion was a great game master. Probably my favorite escape room that we’ve done.

quotes.author: Megha Joshi
quotes.text: clues, set-up, sounds were fantastic" My friends and I went through the Haunted Hotel experience. It was incredibly fun, and you are immersed right from the beginning. I recommend getting there 10 minutes early - definitely urge your party to arrive on time, as it cuts into your escape room time (which is an hour). The clues, set-up, sounds were fantastic, and we cannot wait to return to complete another escape room experience. Also, massive kudos to Brion for explaining the remaining bits of our experience once it was over and for taking lovely photos of us. I definitely recommend this experience!

quotes.author: Yalitza Pena
quotes.text: celebrating my friend’s birthday who LOVES these type of challenges!" We were a group of 6, celebrating my friend’s birthday who LOVES these type of challenges! Our mastermind host, Brion, was awesome! So secretive, so personable, so in tune with our journey from start to finish! Lots of creativity unfolded in our escape and we were all so excited to keep going! Unfortunately, we did not complete the mission! We shall have to go back and try again! 🤭 #Rikers1932
